title: STNFS with both-bars alpha (5.15, 0.85), theta 19/50, slacks (294, 225), UDUP 0.6: 121.32592

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 target, the complete STNFS algorithm in proof.md and DESCENT.md with the REFINEMENT.md refinements, 99.9% ECM, X2 = 2^64, theta = 19/50 collection (proof.md), the measured record route and the STORAGE.md/row_tail.c kernels returns Q satisfying e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success at least 0.394319 (and hence at least 0.39) under disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (with H4u: at least 88% of the filtered matrix row weight is +-1 entries). It computes two GT logarithms and returns Q=[a]Q0, handling z=1 directly. All classical work is bounded by a global meter at 2^121.32592 dense-Fp12 units, C=20,000 instructions, with upper-rounded ledger rows summing to <= 2^121.32592. ECM succeeds with 99.9% per prime; X2 = 2^64; theta=19/50 (1040 rows, a-radius 892) with slacks (294, 225), allowance 1.0674, alpha (5.15, 0.85), primes in [2^63, 2^64) charged twice, records routed at 10.01 each and re-read at 7.003: collection <= 2^121.1547 units. The polynomials, factor-base bound, filtering, kernels and target remain those of the cited source; the 62-node descent plan of REFINEMENT.md/refinement.json (coordinate search with joint moves, 35 entries differ from the base plan, boot unchanged) is evaluated at UDUP = 0.6 and THIN_MAX 85. Linear algebra (STORAGE.md, row_tail.c: 20.7 instructions per sparse entry, 2,710 per row for six-limb transfers, combination and the reduction mod r, 97 per dense term, 420 per further 9-limb reduction, N = 1.096 x 0.0471 U, Block Wiedemann blocks (19, 4)) is <= 2^117.7103 units, generator <= 2^107.1997. Descent credits UDUP = 0.6 distinct relations per raw relation (23% below the measured 0.779 and 28% below the 200-point 1190-unit 0.8353), forces discard only up to 2^90, and keeps 18 boot relations. Expected two-log work is bounded by 2^115.5527; the two-log meter is 2^116.28; Markov abort probability is <= 0.6040334. Other upper bounds are boot failure 4.800e-05 per log, expected nodes 2^17.26, node abort 2^-10.04 and repeats 2^-10.70, with 2/r statistical distance charged. All preprocessing, failed attempts, advice, arithmetic, transfers, sorting, verification and output are included; nothing amortized. Numerical-certificate construction receives an extra 2^50-unit allowance. Memory is at most 2^105 bytes. Source smoothness and production extrapolations stay explicit heuristics. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit of recorded full-recurrence evidence, upward-rounded ledger and success, unchanged prime-window endpoints, and nonzero lower/upper integration controls. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) to mean weight 100 and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).
Optional full recomputation of certificates, region, ledger, retention, ECM, descent and declared bounds (about 30 s natively; longer when emulated).
